title: Manchester Hotel Deals: Compare Prices on Every Site
description: Compare Manchester hotel prices on every big booking site. Where to stay: the Northern Quarter, Deansgate, Spinningfields or Salford Quays.
intro: Gigs, football, shopping or a big night out: compare Manchester hotel prices for your dates across every big booking site.

sections.html: Big concerts, football matches and conferences can fill Manchester hotels and push prices up. If your trip lines up with a big event, compare early, and consider staying a little further out along the Metrolink tram network.

faqs.q: Which area of Manchester is best for a weekend?
faqs.a: The Northern Quarter is known for independent bars and shops, Deansgate and Spinningfields for restaurants and smarter hotels, and Salford Quays for MediaCityUK and waterside views, linked by tram.
